title: Investment Opportunity — Latakia Coastal Land

asset.planningStatus: inside planned zoning — seller claim pending verification
asset.titleClaim: green title deed (طابو أخضر) — document review pending

investmentThesis: A coastal land opportunity in Latakia proposed for a hospitality, resort or tourism development concept. The opportunity is presented as a seller-provided starting point and must pass ownership, planning, site, sanctions/compliance and commercial review before any publication or investor access.
developmentConcept: Hospitality-led mixed commercial concept subject to planning confirmation
highlights: Direct coastal setting as stated by seller
Commercial land use as stated by seller
Proposed hotel, resort or tourism development angle
Indicative asking price of USD 2.5 million
limitations: Area conversion from dunum to square metres is intentionally not assumed
No projected returns, buildable area or approvals are asserted
Investor outreach requires explicit owner approval
Legal, sanctions, title and planning review are outstanding

dueDiligence.item: Obtain and review current green title deed and cadastral extract
Confirm seller identity, authority to sell and encumbrances
Confirm zoning, permitted use, density, height and setbacks with competent authority
Verify boundaries, coastal frontage, access and topography by survey/site visit
Confirm road access and availability of water, power, sewage and telecom
Obtain local legal opinion on transferability, restrictions and transaction structure
Complete sanctions, AML/KYC and cross-border transaction review
Validate asking price and prepare a feasibility study before presenting returns
